description: Header file defining the Thunder::Wayland::Display class and related classes for managing Wayland surfaces, including surface creation, event handling, and EGL integration.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display
classes.description: Main class managing Wayland display, surfaces, input, and EGL context.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback events related to surface attachment and detachment.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::Surface
classes.description: Wrapper class for a Wayland surface implementation.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::Image
classes.description: Wrapper class for an EGL image associated with the display.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of the display for a given display name.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new surface with specified name, dimensions, and callback.

methods.name: SurfaceByName
methods.description: Retrieves a surface by its name.

methods.name: FileDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the display connection.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets the callback handler for display events.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Returns whether the display is in collect mode.

methods.name: Constructed
methods.description: Notifies that a surface has been constructed.

methods.name: Destructed
methods.description: Notifies that a surface has been destructed.

methods.name: FocusKeyboard
methods.description: Sets keyboard focus to a surface.

methods.name: FocusPointer
methods.description: Sets pointer focus to a surface.

methods.name: KeyMapConfiguration
methods.description: Sets key mapping configuration for surfaces.

methods.name: Repeat
methods.description: Sets key repeat rate and delay.
